description: 국가철도공단_역사별 정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 역사별 정보 데이터는 각 역사별 역명, 역 주소, 다국어 역명 등의 기본 정보를 포함하고 있으며, 운영기관 및 노선별로 제공됩니다. 이 데이터는 승객들이 정확한 역 위치와 명칭을 이해할 수 있도록 돕고, 외국인 이용객을 위한 다국어 지원 정보를 포함하여 편리한 이용 환경을 조성합니다. 또한 역 기본 정보... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 역명, 역주소, 다국어역명, 운영기관정보, 노선기본정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
